@tailwindcss/typography v0.5.20 (June 2026): Tailwind CSS v4 installation: npm install -D @tailwindcss/typography. Config: add '@plugin @tailwindcss/typography;' to CSS file (not tailwind.config.js — v4 uses CSS-based config). Usage:
markdown content
. prose-neutral uses neutral color palette. max-w-none removes built-in max-width constraint. Works inside cards/containers. The prose class applies heading/body/list sizing internally.
